nome: Neptune Laundromat — 151 VFW Pkwy, Revere MA
origem: conteudo de junho/2026 da propria loja, embaralhado

posts.description:
Neptune Laundry's pickup and delivery service runs in four steps: schedule, leave your bag out, get your laundry washed and folded, receive it back at your door. This service operates from our 489 Saratoga Street location in East Boston, MA, and covers customers in Revere and the surrounding area.

Step one: schedule a pickup through the Neptune app (available on iOS and Android) or online. Step two: leave your bag outside at the pickup window, no need to be home. Step three: Neptune's team at the Saratoga Street location washes, dries, and folds everything. Step four: your clothes come back folded and ready to put away. Neptune Laundry has been in operation since 1999, which means this process has been refined over 25 years of handling customers' laundry.

East Boston and Revere, MA are neighboring communities, so the route from our Saratoga Street location reaches Revere customers conveniently. Ready to hand off laundry entirely? Schedule your first pickup at our 489 Saratoga Street location through the Neptune app or online.

Neptune Laundry offers $20 off your first pickup order with the code FIRST20, applicable when you schedule pickup through the 489 Saratoga Street location in East Boston, MA. This offer applies to first-time pickup and delivery customers and is redeemable through the Neptune app on iOS and Android, or online.

The pickup and delivery service at the Saratoga Street location in East Boston serves customers in Revere, MA and neighboring communities. Your first order follows the same process as any other: schedule through the app or online, leave your laundry out in any bag you have, and receive it back washed, dried, and folded at your door. The $20 off with code FIRST20 applies to that first order. Neptune Laundry has been in operation since 1999.

Ready to try pickup and delivery for the first time at a discount? Use code FIRST20 when you schedule your first pickup at our 489 Saratoga Street location in East Boston through the Neptune app or online.

Neptune Laundry's pickup and delivery service, available from our 489 Saratoga Street location in East Boston, MA, accepts more than everyday clothing. Comforters, area rugs, and other oversized household items are accepted for pickup, washed with commercial-grade machines, and returned ready to use.

Large items are often the most inconvenient to wash at home and the most difficult to fit into a standard residential machine. A comforter that occupies an entire home washer and dryer can be handled in a single commercial cycle at Neptune's Saratoga Street location, then returned through the pickup route that serves Revere, MA and the surrounding area. Neptune Laundry has been in operation since 1999.

Is there a comforter, rug, or bulky household item that has been sitting on your to-do list because it does not fit your home machine? Schedule a pickup at our 489 Saratoga Street location in East Boston through the Neptune app on iOS and Android, or online.
